hypothesis: Adding the already isolated foreign-parent mechanism to scale-aware UCB restores complementary progress while retaining useful resource concentration.
isolated_change: Same scaled selector, W=10, c=.07 and native arms; enable external second parent every ten crossover events. Live feedback responds to the new children. Allocation changes are a mediator of enabling cooperation, not claimed as fixed-allocation causal evidence (that is I1).
comparison: Primary combined vs scaled; secondary vs original, I1, uniform and all individuals. Reject combination if it fails to improve HV and AUC over scaled or violates diversity/time gates.
